title: Restricted-over abelian cohomology presentation
statement: Let k:W→S be a scheme morphism, F an abelian etale sheaf on W, q an integer, I a small cofiltered category, D:I→Over W a diagram with affine transition maps and qcqs composites D(i)→W→S, and c a cone with limiting underlying scheme cone and qcqs composite c.pt→W→S. Let U be an affine etale S-scheme. There exist H:I opposite→Ab, a cocone B, isomorphisms from H(i) to the explicit restrictedOverCohomology(k,F,q,D(i),U) and from B.pt to the corresponding apex cohomology, such that H,B admit EtaleComplexCohomologyPresentationData and the isomorphisms intertwine every transition and leg with the explicitly defined restrictedOverCohomologyMap.

proof.text: Identify the explicit cohomology map with pullback on the single complex followed by its coefficient comparison. The existing identity and composition laws, together with the single-complex unit/composition comparisons, prove functoriality and the cone-leg equation. Construct H and B explicitly with these maps, use identity isomorphisms for the comparisons, and apply restrictedOverAbelianCocone_complex_data.

proof_origin.place: Proof and comparison calculations formalized by E1; complete argument in the declaration docstring.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_restrictedOverAbelian_cohomology_presentation
    {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (F : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℤ)
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I] (D : I ⥤ Over W)
    [∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f).left]
    [∀ i, QuasiCompact ((D.obj i).hom ≫ k)]
    [∀ i, QuasiSeparated ((D.obj i).hom ≫ k)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget W).mapCone c))
    [QuasiCompact (c.pt.hom ≫ k)] [QuasiSeparated (c.pt.hom ≫ k)]
    (U : S.Etale) [IsAffine U.left] :
    ∃ (H : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (B : Cocone H)
      (e : ∀ i : I, H.obj (op i) ≅ restrictedOverCohomology k F q (D.obj i) U)
      (e₀ : B.pt ≅ restrictedOverCohomology k F q c.pt U),
      EtaleComplexCohomologyPresentationData H B ∧
      (∀ (i j : I) (f : j ⟶ i), H.map f.op ≫ (e j).hom =
        (e i).hom ≫ restrictedOverCohomologyMap k F q (D.map f) U) ∧
      (∀ i : I, B.ι.app (op i) ≫ e₀.hom =
        (e i).hom ≫ restrictedOverCohomologyMap k F q (c.π.app i) U)
